representative_scale.step_count_reason: Published baseline uses timeIntegration calibration, not a fixed published integration-step count.

inputs.required: All three input files listed in data.json plus pinned benchmark.py and OpenMM 8.2.0 CUDA runtime.
inputs.seeds: Distinct automatically generated seeds per independent Context; explicit seed numbers unavailable.

required: Two stdout records containing pme, ns_per_day, elapsed_time, steps, timestep_in_fs and configuration
Aggregate throughput in ns/day from summing the two rates
Hardware, driver and actual OpenMM version
outputs.scoring_interface: Parse named stdout fields printed by benchmark.py. Missing pme result invalidates measurement even if exit status is zero: script catches OpenMMException. No numerical pass/fail tolerance exists.

timing_scope.baseline: Each timeIntegration call performs initial warm-up steps and energy synchronization before timer; times integration plus final energy synchronization. Source setup, imports, data parsing, Context creation and earlier calibration calls excluded from final elapsed_time.
timing_scope.aggregate: Sum per-process reported rates from concurrent runs, as article throughput approach. End-to-end wall time is separate and not interchangeable.

budget_feasibility.reason: No builds or workloads allowed during intake. Two 60-second targets expected below default 1200-second stage budgets; installation, calibration and runtime bounds unverified. No new workload or doubling/scale-search loop specified.

unavailable.gate_scripts: No gate script named in prompt.
